idea: How to stop checking your phone at work
text:
I used to glance at my phone every few minutes at work, and it broke my focus.

I put my phone in a drawer instead of on my desk. Out of sight keeps my brain from tracking notifications. If I can see it, my attention drifts toward it automatically. Try one drawer or a bag across the room. If you still reach, move it further away.

I set a timer for thirty minutes of work before any phone look. A fixed window gives my mind permission to wait. Without a limit, checking becomes a habit loop. Watch for the urge to grab it before the timer ends. If it hits early, reset the timer and keep working.

I replace the reach with a quick note on paper. Writing down a thought keeps my task moving. It fills the same itch without pulling me into apps. Keep a pad next to your keyboard. If you catch your hand moving, write one word instead.

Those steps keep my focus where it needs to be.
title: Stop checking your phone at work
